Claim: PM loop round 5, next slot. The direction is the card's own: the maintainer's order it quotes (「Home 页的应用卡片不是链接，没法在新标签页打开。」) and its "Expected".
- Each "Your apps" tile is a real link to the app's route, the same address `onOpen` navigates to today. It keeps its look.
- The browser's link affordances work: middle-click, ⌘/Ctrl-click, "Open link in new tab", "Copy link address", and the hover destination.
- A plain left-click still navigates in place.

Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12305-home-app-tiles-are-links`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12305`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the Home apps strip and its two mounts, read on objectui `main` `093d55b` at 2026-10-13T07:07Z. Stop on a breach and explain it in the report.
- **The strip:** `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeAppsStrip.tsx`. Each tile is `<button type="button" onClick={() => onOpen(app)}>`.
- **Its two mounts:** both pass `onOpen` as a `navigate()` to `/apps/${appRouteSegment(app) ?? app.name}`.
  - `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`.
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/app-launcher-renderer.tsx`, the `app-launcher` block.
- Co-located tests and a changeset.
- ⛔ The "More" / "Show less" controls and the marketplace shortcut stay buttons, because they navigate nowhere addressable. ⛔ No new export, spec key or i18n key unless the report justifies it.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason:
- `HomeAppsStrip` is not exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry, so its props are internal.
- The `app-launcher` block's schema does not move.
- No published type, export or accepted input moves, and none of the three contract surfaces is touched.
Responsibility: `app-shell's HomeAppsStrip (tiles rendered as buttons with an in-place navigate) | none: react-router's Link already gives an in-place click plus the browser's link affordances | every console user on Home, and every page that places the app-launcher block, opening an app in a new tab or copying its address (reported on the card by the browser-pass runners)`
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-13T07:07Z on objectui `main` `093d55b`.
- No open PR touches `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/**` or `views/app-launcher-renderer.tsx` (objectui#12313, #12309, #11845, #11844 and #11600 read).
- This seat's in-flight work shares no file: objectui#12309 (in the merge queue), objectui#12313 (`AppManagementPage.tsx`, `data-objectstack`, i18n packs) and the objectui#12295 dev (`data-objectstack`, `layout/AppHeader.tsx`, `layout/ConnectionStatus.tsx`).
